Is TSTGEN00 modernised, retired, replaced by a framework/test-data service, or kept as test tooling?

UTLMNT00 is a confirmed utility (control-file-driven file maintenance: routes by CTL-FUNCTION 'ARCHIVE' / 'CLEANUP' / 'REORG' / 'ANALYZE', BR-128; ends with return code 12 after more than 100 errors, BR-125). Is UTLMNT00 modernised, retired, replaced by platform/storage services, or kept as operational tooling?

UTLMNT00 is classified utility (confirmed): classified as utility (confirmed); a human must decide whether it is in modernisation scope. Keep it in the modernisation scope (resolved_no_change) or exclude it (excluded_from_scope)?

Should the reverse data agent register Field IDs for record-level elementary items so their Java types can be fixed?

WS-ERROR-MESSAGE is referenced but declared nowhere in TSTGEN00, TSTVAL00, UTLMNT00, UTLMON00 and UTLVAL00 (it may have been expected from ERRHAND or RTNCODE). What is its intended layout and owning copybook?
UTLMNT00 ARCHIVE-FILE is RECORDING MODE V with a single X(32760) record. What is the actual archive record format (lengths and content) that the Java writer must reproduce?
